subtasks.title: Confirm PRD diff is purely cosmetic and verify zero downstream impact
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/010_3032ca2a8723/architecture/delta-analysis.md for the full diff analysis. The PRD diff between session 009's prd_snapshot.md and the current PRD.md contains exactly three changes: (a) markdown table column re-alignment in §9.7.3 (Discovery, Layering & File Locations table, lines ~832–836), (b) markdown table column re-alignment in §9.7.5 (Schema Reference table, lines ~858–897), and (c) one trailing blank line at line 1036. All three are formatting-only with zero semantic change. The change classifier at src/core/change-classifier.ts implements classifyChange() which uses an LLM to classify diffs as COSMETIC or SUBSTANTIVE with a protective SUBSTANTIVE default (§4.3). No code, config, or test files parse the PRD's markdown table formatting for behavioral logic — verified via grep across src/ and tests/.
2. INPUT: The diff output from `diff plan/009_94353b1a9fd3/prd_snapshot.md PRD.md` showing only table re-alignment and blank-line changes.
3. LOGIC: Verify the diff is purely cosmetic by confirming: (a) no new requirements were added, (b) no existing requirements were modified, (c) no requirements were removed, (d) the change classifier (src/core/change-classifier.ts) correctly distinguishes COSMETIC from SUBSTANTIVE changes per §4.3. Write or update a test that exercises the classifier with a cosmetic diff fixture (markdown table re-alignment) and asserts it returns 'COSMETIC'. If such a test already exists (check tests/unit/core/ and tests/integration/), verify it covers this specific pattern.
4. OUTPUT: Confirmation (test passing or existing coverage verified) that cosmetic table-formatting changes are correctly classified as COSMETIC, and a written assertion in the architecture notes that this delta requires zero implementation work.
5. DOCS: none — no user-facing/config/API surface change. The cosmetic delta itself is in PRD.md (human-owned, read-only).

subtasks.title: Verify README, CONFIGURATION, ARCHITECTURE, and .env.example need no updates for cosmetic delta
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/010_3032ca2a8723/architecture/implementation_status.md for the doc analysis. docs/CONFIGURATION.md (53KB) contains 32 references to canonical PRP_* names but uses a grouped-by-section table format (e.g. `[models]` section → `high`, `balanced`, `fast` keys), NOT the PRD's per-row schema table format. README.md has 2 references to `.hack` config conceptually. .env.example uses canonical PRP_MODEL_HIGH/BALANCED/FAST and PRP_API_BASE_URL names. None of these docs mirror the exact markdown table column formatting that was changed in the PRD.
2. INPUT: Confirmation from P1.M1.T1.S1 that the delta is purely cosmetic.
3. LOGIC: For each doc file (README.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, .env.example), verify it does not contain a verbatim copy of the PRD's §9.7.3 or §9.7.5 markdown tables that would need column re-alignment. If any doc DOES contain a verbatim copy of either table, update its formatting to match the PRD. If no doc contains a verbatim copy (expected outcome), document this finding.
4. OUTPUT: A verified assertion that no documentation files require updates, OR updated doc files if any verbatim table copies were found.
5. DOCS: This IS the documentation sync task. Verify/update README.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md sections that reference the .hack schema or configuration layering to ensure they remain consistent with the PRD's current formatting conventions.
